name: SPZ Packed Gaussian Unpacking
definition: Decodes compressed Gaussian Splat attributes (positions, scales, rotations, alphas, colors, SH) from the SPZ file format into floating-point arrays, handling coordinate system conversion and quantization inversion.
summary: SPZ Packed Gaussian Unpacking decodes compressed Gaussian Splat attributes from the SPZ file format into floating-point arrays using binary ZSTD compression and specific quantized encodings.
